  • Class
    Description
    Agent
    Anything that can publish messages to topics and/or subscribe to them
    AggregatorAgent
    Base class for agents that combine N input topics into a single output value (PlusAgent, MulAgent, AvgAgent, ...).
    AvgAgent
    Publishes the average of all input topics on pubs[0].
    BinOpAgent
    Generic two-input agent that applies a BinaryOperator on the two inputs and publishes the result.
    DivAgent
    Publishes subs[0] / subs[1] on pubs[0].
    IncAgent
    Publishes subs[0] + 1 on pubs[0] every time it receives a message.
    MulAgent
    Publishes the product of all input topics on pubs[0].
    ParallelAgent
    Wraps an agent so its callback runs on its own thread.
    PlusAgent
    Publishes the sum of all input topics on pubs[0].
